تتياسري (form VI)
# تَتَيَاسَرِي (tatayāsarī) /ta.ta.jaː.sa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# تُتَيَاسَرِي (tutayāsarī) /tu.ta.jaː.sa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
